title: Software migration jobs
bodyMd:
A successful job transfers all required fields without manual repair. Failed jobs still count in the total attempts.

| Category | Attempted jobs | Successful jobs |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ledger | 120 | 96 |
| Stock | 180 | 144 |
| Payroll | 300 | 270 |
